headline: IDFC First Bank Reports Record Quarterly Profit Above Rs 1,000 Crore
summary: IDFC First Bank posted strong profit growth for the second quarter, crossing the milestone of Rs 1,000 crore in net earnings.
why: IDFC First Bank is a prominent Indian private sector lender expanding its retail and commercial banking portfolio.

impacts.name: IDFC First Bank Limited
impacts.why: Reaching record quarterly net profit benchmarks reinforces capital adequacy and loan book profitability.
